references.text: Jotbathah is also mentioned in Deuteronomy 10:7 as a place with streams and water springs, where the Israelites camped during their journey through the wilderness.
Previous campsite on the route - the Israelites came from Hor-haggidgad (also called Gudgodah) before they camped at Jotbathah.
Next campsite on the route - from Jotbathah the Israelites continued to Ebronah.
